WHITE WOLF IS MOVING OFFICES!
White Wolf Publishing will be moving our offices the week of March 25th.

All orders placed after 12:00 noon EST on Friday March 22nd will not be
processed until Monday, April 1st.

Our new address is:
1554 Litton Drive
Stone Mountain, GA 30083

Our business phone numbers will remain the same.
We are expecting some internet downtime as
we transition our servers next week.

[This means I may not be able to check my email as often as normal, but
I should still be able to read the newsgroup -lsj]

We will post specific downtimes when we get them.
